---
title: "Kis Bulandi Par Khudaya Martaba Zahra Ka Hai"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Takallum"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Kis Bulandi Par Khudaya Martaba Zahra Ka Hai.
Parda-e-Meraj Mein Bhi Tazkira Zahra Ka Hai.
Be-Niyazaon Mein Kahin Aapas Mein Hota Hai Hisab.
Jo Khuda Ka Hai Samajh Lein Fatima Zahra Ka Hai.

2
Shabar-o-Shabir Jaise Aliman-e-Ghaiab Bhi.
Dars Letay Hain Jahan Woh Madrisa Zahra Ka Hai.
Tohfa-e-Shadi Diya Dono Ko Yeh ALLAH Ne.
Arsh Haider Ka Hai Shehar-e-Karbala Zahra Ka Hai.

3
Iss Makaan Par Sorah-e-Kausar Ki Takhti Hai Lagi.
Ay Khuda-e-Lam Yazal Kaba Bhi Kya Zahra Ka Hai.
Arsh Ka Malik Takallum Aa Raha Hai Bar Bar.
Ossko Bhi Maloom Hai Farsh-e-Azza Zahra Ka Hai.

roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
for edition, numbers in [(roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')]:

    assert len(blocks) == 3

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions have three matching four-verse stanzas. Added the Urdu title, moved the Roman title to `alternateTitle`, set right-to-left direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous Roman phrase “Aliman-e-Ghaiab” as عالمانِ غیب.
